[WP] You started hearing them a month ago. Voices at the edge of your hearing, speaking in a language unknown to you. Today, while sitting in a cafe, you overhear someone speaking that language.

I grew up with the Internet. We were born more or less around the same time. I guess the Internet could be my older sibling by a few years, if you want to be exact about it. I have always been curious about things from before I was born though. My dad had a collection of those old CDs - the big black ones that you needed a needle to play them with.

Have you ever tried putting one of those in reverse? Like people say you should do to find satanical messages on Pink Floyd albums and The Beatles'? I hope you haven't, it's a terrible sound that creeps up on your very bones. And it's all I have been hearing for the past few weeks.

It all started one night. I thought a neighbor had forgotten his TV on or something - I was hearing this low discourse, barely audible. I had a little trouble sleeping due to the noise and was surprised to still hear it by morning. As I went to work and it kept going I knew something was wrong. I'm not sure if it got louder as the days passed or if I was just focusing more and more of my attention on it, so it sounded clearer. But I swear, it was people screaming. It got so bad that I have stopped going hiking because out of town, where the background noise is gone, I just can't stand to hear that sound - as if hundreds of people are screaming in unison. It terrifies me. I have set a doctor's appointment but it's only for next week. Everything was fine though since the voices seemed to tone down a lot in the last few days.

Today though everything changed. I was on a café when I noticed the noise start to blend with the chatter of people around me. It was weird, almost as when a passing ambulance is getting closer and closer to you and then moving away again - just by the sound you know how close it is and whether it's coming or going...

So it was almost like that and then for an instant, I swear, those voices had exactly the same discourse and tone as the black couple sitting right next to me! From that point onward the voices in my head... they are talking in normal speech. Still like a hundred different people saying different things but now they're holding normal conversations. It's as if they could be someone just across the street. It all makes sense to me.

So as I write this I have just realized: what happened today at the café... I don't know why or how but I just know I was hearing words in reverse before, coming from the future, I think. Somehow today I crossed a threshold and now the words that make sense are sounds from the past, ever more distant as the minutes go onward for myself And I'm terrified. Terrified, because if my little theory is correct then I know something will happen soon, in a couple of days and we will all be screaming and agonizing in pain until the day we die!
